title: Speaking — Visiting museums
description: Part 1 interview, a cue card and a Part 3 discussion on visiting museums.

questions: What places are within walking distance of your home?
When are the streets near your home most lively?
Which part of the area would you show to a visitor?
What kind of exhibitions would you like to visit?
Do you prefer to explore a museum alone or with someone?

part2.topic: Describe an exhibit that made you ask new questions.
part2.closing: and explain what you wanted to find out after seeing it.

questions: Should museums change their displays frequently or keep familiar exhibits?
How could museums serve people who cannot visit in person?
How has everyday life connected with visiting museums changed for people of different ages?
